name: Troubleshooting guide
about: Starter for the faults of one product or system. Generic headings only: rename, delete and fill them. Everything it adds comes in "to verify".

items.title: Safety first
items.notes: What must be isolated or checked before anyone works on it.

items.title: Alarms and codes
items.notes: Each alarm or fault code, one branch each: what it means, the likely causes, what to check.

items.title: Symptoms without an alarm
items.notes: What people notice (noise, no cooling, leaks), one branch each, with the causes to check in order.

items.title: Measurements
items.notes: The readings to take, with units, where to take them, and the normal range.

items.title: Parts often replaced
items.notes: Parts that fail most, how to tell, and how to order them.

items.title: When to escalate
items.notes: What the site cannot fix, and who to call with which information.
